scope: reg 6 (s 586 inquiries); reg 8 with s 3 (full-time worker, 35 hours); reg 9 with Sch 2 items 2-8 of the 2013 Act (38 hours; item 8 computed); reg 10 with Sch 1 cl 6(3) (timber contractors, 25%); reg 11 and Sch 2 of the Regulations with Sch 1 cl 9(5)(c) (contractors' percentages); reg 12 with s 175(4) (proof of identity and incapacity overseas at 3-month intervals); reg 13 with s 179(5)-(7) (30 days to reimburse an employer); regs 14 and 15 with s 388 (self-insurer contributions, due dates, recovery after 14 days). Out: regs 1-5 and Sch 1 (machinery, search warrant form), reg 7 (evidentiary certificates), the Accident Compensation Act 1985 limbs of regs 9, 12 and 13.
